US [webresearch]: The failure list reads like our incident log (walltime-bound trains, fake success, parallel checkpoint writers). Even frontier agents fail at executing research, not at searching. Our loop must enforce baseline replication before each increment, detect job failures, and gate every keep-or-rollback decision on a measured holdout score, never on the agent's narrative.
